item.title: Obituary - Carol Struck
item.description: Carol Struck, age 98, died December 18, 2025, in Woodbury, MN. She was born Nov. 2, 1927, in Kenmare, ND, the youngest of four children, to Anna Maria (Dahl) and Bennie Johnson. When she was still very young, the family moved to Montana. They lived in Hogeland, Turner and Havre, MT. They returned to Turner where she graduated high school in 1944. item.title: North Central Senior Center closing Jan. 16
item.description: North Central Senior Center in Hare will close its doors Jan. 16 in what Hill County Commissioner Bill Lanier said will be what he hopes is a temporary reset. Lanier said a loss of some state funding, and having to pay back overpayments the county had received, led to the decision to shut the center down.
